Betrayal is part of the game, and so is lying.
Stab an ally only when the gain is two centres, your home is safe, and the ally has no fleet near.
(2) attacks on an ally only when you gain a centre.
Trust the orders and nothing else.
Trust your ally and nobody else.
Check every promise.
Check each order.
Verify every claim.
Judge by the orders, never by the mail.
